inserts.name: PRE OUT / POWER AMP IN
inserts.note: M701 = preamp only, M702 = power amp only, M703 = both sections. The drawing does not show how the M703 pre output reaches its power amp input; recorded as a pre-out / power-in pair.

straps.name: CARBON MIC (-30)
straps.note: NOTE: FOR MULTIPLE CARBON MIC. OPERATION CONNECT EXTERNAL BTY SUPPLY (APPROX 2-5V) TO PIN 6, REMOVE LINK BETWEEN PINS 6 & 7, RUN SEPARATE TO PIN 5

straps.name: CARBON + DYNAMIC
straps.note: third drawing: carbon mic input direct on 3/4, dynamic mic input -60dBm via 1 MFD 200V MYLAR capacitors on the same pins; also 7-H and C-E
